title: Transcript A: the original working transcript
date: 27 October 2026 (recording date inferred; see Open questions)
origin: Automatic speech-to-text transcript of a recorded conversation between the narrator and a grandchild, the transcript from which this archive was first built. Speakers are not labelled; one paragraph per line, separated by blank lines, so paragraph numbers are odd line numbers.

title: Transcript B: companion transcript of the same recording
origin: A second, independent speech-to-text pass over the same recording, added during the audit. Often clearer on names (Clonmel, Louth Militia, Fighting Atty, Vere, Galter, Rathnew), but not infallible: it has its own errors (“RUC”, “Royal Irish Conservatory”, “Yall”, “York”). No audio was available to settle differences between the transcripts. The phone number in the original file name is masked here; it is not part of the transcript.

title: Transcript C: the second recording (28 October 2026)
date: 28 October 2026 (the day after the first recording: "I've mentioned yesterday Eliza", C¶8; file name "28.txt")
origin: Automatic speech-to-text transcript of a second recorded conversation between the narrator and the interviewer, made the next day, first in the narrator's study and then at a neighbouring family house, while the two looked through the family's papers (the family Bible, Bellingham Arthur's genealogical notebooks, the family's annotated copy of the Visitation of Ireland, the 1924 confirmation of arms, a 1929 newspaper cutting and the pedigree rolls of the 1950s) and its portraits. There is only one transcript of this recording. Speakers are not labelled; one paragraph per line, so paragraph numbers are line numbers. Complete as received, except that a four-digit device PIN spoken in ¶43 is replaced by "[PIN removed]": it is a credential, not family history.
